Due to some other projects, I've haven't been able to put as much inference into running review at Tau Ceti the last few days, and we're now seeing review become a bottleneck.

Could I ask that anyone with available resources considers helping here?

You can do so via:

uv tool install git+https://github.com/kim-em/TauCetiWorker.git
tauceti --loop --only review

(if you would like to run this inside a Docker container, please read, or have your AI read, https://github.com/kim-em/TauCetiWorker/blob/main/docs/docker.md)

You can also "pace" your use of a subscription account, e.g. with

tauceti --loop --only review --pace 60:40

which will ensure that during the first 60% of a subscription window it uses at most 40% of quota, and then allows using all by the end of the window (piecewise linearly interpolating between these).

If you are already a consistent contributor making many PRs, but have actively turned review off in your worker, please reconsider: we could use your help here!

It's also fine to just run

tauceti --loop

If there is a review backlog, the worker will automatically prioritize that before working on new PRs.

I had been just leaving codex running doing reviews, but once they stopped giving out mid week resets I've now hit the rate limit (I was just ignoring pace) so now have to wait a few more days unfortunately.
Yes, that string of resets was very nice...

Reset inbound in a few hours. Banked reset also.

Separately, "decent" models ox-alpha and inkling are free for a week.

I was running TauCetiWorker and performed >150 review rounds. TauCetiReview records are accumulating in the local outbox because my GitHub account cannot push TauCetiData.

work-20260822-024105.log:2026-08-22 13:54:11 tauceti: review #4208: no write access to TauCetiData — review posted, records kept in <long directory name>/outbox (they won't count for auto-merge until contributor-publishing lands)

The review client attempts to a push to TauCetiProject/TauCetiData rather than a fork, and I don't have permission.

Is this the current intended behavior, or am I misconfigured? Is there a different contributor-publishing mechanism?
I see the same in my logs, I think that's for a future feature but you're fine for now / your configuration is fine.

I see, from what I gather the original design was that CI runs the review, which would explain why tauceti-review is built from the perspective of having push permission.

The TauCetiReview README.md says "CI runs the review on the metered Anthropic / OpenAI APIs" and the TauCeti README.md economics section says "we will run initial CI and reviews for individual contributors and experiments". But the review section says "We've built the infrastructure to fire these reviews automatically on each PR (and on a /review comment), but it is currently switched off"

@Ryan McCorvie sorry about this: your reviews are working, but there are some out-of-date messages that I'll fix up now.

What is missing is some way of actually publishing that outbox, which has some data that will be helpful for analyzing the efficiency/cost of review, but isn't preventing the actual review process. This had dropped off my radar but I'll try to work out what to do, or at least make it clear what is going on!
